title: Support users' visibility, attribution and extra capabilities
question: Where must Track3D support users be hidden from customers? How are their actions attributed in notifications and history, and which extra capabilities do they get?
context: The historical PRD asks for hidden support users, anonymised "ConstructN" attribution and extra capabilities (USER-REQ-052..054). The code hides them in some lists and counts only. The scope of support access is unconfirmed.
